core_obligations: (1)-(3): cite the registered projectivity, commutativity, and degree lemmas (S7 cards).
(4): a surjective morphism of varieties over an algebraically closed field induces a surjection on k-points; (4) follows from (3).
(5): registered degree lemma + base change of finite locally free preserves degree (one-step).
(6): registered etale-multiplication lemma (this batch) gives the iff on [n]; A[n] = fibre over e, etale base change one way; the converse via the two cited Morphisms lemmas.

(7): A[l](k) finite of order l^{2g} (degree + etale over k = k-bar), annihilated by l, hence (Z/l)^{2g} by structure theory; divisibility SES 0 -> A(k)[l] -> A(k)[l^2] -> A(k)[l] -> 0 (surjectivity by divisibility, kernel elementary); induct on the exponent; primary parts for composite n.
(8): same template with the registered multiplication-by-p lemma giving A(k)[p] = (Z/p)^f, 0 <= f <= g.
proof_roadmap: citation assembly for (1)-(3),(5); carried dictionary and structure-theory arguments for (4),(6),(7); (8) same-template on a cited base.
